title: Smooth linearization of nonautonomous dynamics under general dichotomic behaviour
summary: The main purpose of this paper is to formulate new conditions for smooth linearization of nonautonomous systems with discrete and continuous time. Our results assume that the linear part admits a very general form of dichotomy known as $μ$-dichotomy and that the associated $μ$-dichotomy spectrum exhibits appropriate spectral gap and spectral band conditions. We observe that our notion of $μ$-dichotomy encompasses the classical notions of exponential, polynomial and logarithmic dichotomies as very particular cases.
